data.title: Addtech Signs Agreement to Acquire Lott-Lacke
data.description:
Addtech AB Class B ( ($SE:ADDT.B) ) just unveiled an update.

Addtech is a technical solutions group operating in selected niches for advanced technology products and solutions, connecting manufacturers with customers. Its customers primarily operate in manufacturing and infrastructure, and the group has about 5,000 employees across more than 150 subsidiaries, with annual sales above SEK 23 billion.

Addtech Industry has signed an agreement to acquire 100% of Lott-Lacke Produktions- und Handels GmbH, a Germany-headquartered company that develops, manufactures and supplies customised radiation-curing and water-based specialty coatings for industrial applications. Lott-Lacke has approximately 29 employees, annual sales of approximately EUR 25 million and more than half of its sales outside Germany.

data.title: Rainbow Polikarbonat Repurchases 420,974 RNPOL Shares
data.description:
Rainbow Polikarbonat Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:RNPOL) ) has shared an update.

Rainbow Polikarbonat Sanayi Ticaret A.Ş. repurchased 420,974 Group B RNPOL shares on Borsa İstanbul on Nov. 26, 2026, at prices ranging from TRY 2.00 to TRY 2.04 per share. The company stated that the buy-back aims to limit the effects of recent adverse market conditions on its shares and protect shareholders’ rights and interests.

The buy-back provides for the acquisition of 50,000,000 nominal TRY in shares, with a maximum payment of TRY 200,000,000. With the latest transaction, cumulative repurchases reached 27,064,657 shares, equivalent to 4.5108% of the company’s share capital.

data.title: Triton Minerals Announces Board Changes
data.description:
Triton Minerals Limited ( (AU:TON) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Triton Minerals Limited announced immediate changes to its board, appointing Chengzhou Hou as chairman and director and Bingchao Yan as a director. The appointments followed nominations by Jigao International Investment Development Co., Ltd under director nomination arrangements in a 25 June 2019 Subscription Agreement.

Peng (Rod) Zhang and Xingmin (Max) Ji resigned as directors, effective immediately. Hou brings corporate, investment and management experience, while Yan is a qualified mining engineer with experience in mine operations, engineering, project development, safety and technical management.

The board now comprises Hou, executive director Adrian Costello, non-executive director Yang Li and Yan. Remuneration and other appointment terms for Hou and Yan are still being finalized.
